live_test: Discovered the real service live (the research doc only sketched a URL): enumerated smgis.sanmarcostx.gov's ArcGIS REST catalog (needs a User-Agent header, same as Arlington) to find Planning/CoSM_BuildingPermits/FeatureServer/0, inspected its real field list (ADDRESS/STATUS/DESCRIPTION/LANDUSE/TYPE/APPLIED/ISSUED/SQUAREFEET/PERMITID/PROJECTNUMBER/ProjectName -- no units field), then ran the exact where clause above and got 168 real rows since 2024-09-01 with exceededTransferLimit=false (no paging needed here), e.g. '3810 TRANSPORTATION WAY APT 329' / 'The 1856 Apartments Stair Remodel' at 1805 N IH 35.
notes: This layer's granularity is per building-unit/per-permit, not per-project -- e.g. '3810 TRANSPORTATION WAY APT 301/303/304/329' are 4 separate rows for one building, so this recipe's output leans on find_upcoming's existing merge_records address-based merge to collapse them, and will still under-count true unit totals since there is no aggregate unit-count field on this layer (units stay None, 'Units: not public yet', never estimated from row count). LANDUSE='Multi-Family' is the closest verified real apartment-relevant filter found live; there is no separate apartment-only sub-code on this layer.
